newsitem.title: FRANCE: 26 million Europeans have erection woes-scientist.
newsitem.headline: 26 million Europeans have erection woes-scientist.

text.p: About 26 million European men have regular problems getting an erection, a French scientist said on Tuesday.

Dr Alain Jardin, chief urologist at the Kremlin-Bicetre hospital in Paris, told a news conference that about one in 10 of Europe's 260 million males over the age of 18 had difficulty getting an erection at least once out of every two times they attempted to have sex.

A 1994 survey conducted in France found that only about one in five individuals with erection problems ever consulted a physician about their condition even though several courses of treatment were available, Jardin said.
